# Part 1: Staff YouTube Data

## A. Predict

- **Watch history:** about 5 records: Rosling, Texas Sun (twice), Tú sí sabes quererme, Sinnerman. Unsure: the stalled Rosling page, the CLT preview, and the ads.
- **Search history:** 4 records: hans rosling 200 countries, 3blue1brown central limit theorem, galton board, hasta la raíz
- **stat133 playlist:** Rosling, Texas Sun, Tú sí sabes quererme, Central Limit Theorem
- **Subscriptions:** 3Blue1Brown, Khruangbin

## B. Import

```{r}
#| label: p1-b
#| echo: false
list.files("data-staff/YouTube and YouTube Music", recursive = TRUE)

watches  <- fromJSON("data-staff/YouTube and YouTube Music/history/watch-history.json")
searches <- fromJSON("data-staff/YouTube and YouTube Music/history/search-history.json")
playlists     <- read_csv("data-staff/YouTube and YouTube Music/playlists/playlists.csv")
stat133       <- read_csv("data-staff/YouTube and YouTube Music/playlists/stat133-videos.csv")
subscriptions <- read_csv("data-staff/YouTube and YouTube Music/subscriptions/subscriptions.csv")

watches |>
  select(header, title, titleUrl, time) |>
  head(3) |>
  gt()
```

## C. Clean

```{r}
#| label: p1-c
#| echo: false
watches <- watches |>
  unnest(subtitles, keep_empty = TRUE) |>
  rename(channel = name) |>
  mutate(
    title    = str_replace(title, "^Watched ", ""),   # anchor: only at the start
    video_id = str_extract(titleUrl, "[^=]+$"),        # everything after the last "="
    artist   = str_replace(title, " - .*", ""),        # drop " - " and everything after
    song     = str_replace(title, "^[^-]+ - ", "")     # drop everything up to the first " - "
  )

searches <- searches |>
  mutate(terms = str_extract(titleUrl, "[^=]+$"))

watches  |> select(title, channel, video_id, artist, song) |> gt()
searches |> select(title, terms) |> gt()
```

## D. Check the Times

```{r}
#| label: p1-d
#| echo: false
what_we_did <- tibble(
  video_id    = c("jbkSRLYSojo", "ABLT6hdgEek", "4IACZdwwJI4", "Whe7MURlKLw"),
  what_we_did = c("12:50:17", "13:02:34", "13:09:25", "13:15:31")
)

watches <- watches |>
  mutate(
    time    = ymd_hms(time),
    time_pt = with_tz(time, tzone = "America/Los_Angeles")
  )

watches |>
  left_join(what_we_did, by = join_by(video_id)) |>
  mutate(recorded_pt = format(time_pt, "%H:%M:%S")) |>
  select(title, recorded_pt, what_we_did) |>
  arrange(recorded_pt) |>
  gt()
```

## E. Join

```{r}
#| label: p1-e
#| echo: false
# Saved to stat133 but never watched
anti_join(stat133, watches, by = join_by(`Video ID` == video_id)) |>
  select(`Video ID`) |>
  gt()

# Watched but never saved
anti_join(watches, stat133, by = join_by(video_id == `Video ID`)) |>
  select(title, video_id) |>
  gt()

# Subscriptions joined to watches by channel name
left_join(subscriptions, watches, by = join_by(`Channel Title` == channel)) |>
  select(`Channel Title`, title) |>
  gt()
```

## F. Compare to the Record

**Actions that left no trace:**

- The first Texas Sun watch (12:56), replaced by the replay at 13:15
- The stalled Rosling page (12:43)
- The silent CLT preview in the search results
- All five ads, and skipping the St. Jude ad
- The Like on Tú sí sabes quererme
- Pausing Sinnerman and Texas Sun, and when any video ended
- When each subscription happened, and choosing Khruangbin out of three channels

**What watch history records:** one row per video, at the moment the video itself
started, keeping only the most recent start and only the uploading channel.
13 seconds of Sinnerman counts the same as all of Texas Sun.

**For my own data:** a row is not always a play. A rewatch soon after the first
can replace the earlier row, and a row doesn't tell me how much of a video I watched.

# Part 2: Your App, Your Data

## A. Take Inventory

```{r}
#| label: p2-a
#| echo: false
my_files <- list.files("data/Takeout/YouTube and YouTube Music", recursive = TRUE)

# Count files by format, using regex on the end of each name
tibble(file = my_files) |>
  mutate(format = case_when(
    str_detect(file, "\\.json$") ~ "JSON",
    str_detect(file, "\\.csv$")  ~ "CSV",
    TRUE                         ~ "Other"
  )) |>
  count(format) |>
  gt()

# Read the event log and open up the channel column
events <- fromJSON("data/Takeout/YouTube and YouTube Music/history/watch-history.json")
nrow(events)
events <- unnest(events, subtitles, keep_empty = TRUE)
nrow(events)

events |>
  select(title, name, time) |>
  head(5) |>
  gt()
```

## B. When Did It Happen?

```{r}
#| label: p2-b
#| echo: false
# Parse the text times, then show them on the Pacific clock
events <- events |>
  mutate(
    time = ymd_hms(time),
    time = with_tz(time, tzone = "America/Los_Angeles")
  )

# Start, end, and span of the log
log_start <- min(events$time)
log_end   <- max(events$time)
log_span <- as.duration(log_end - log_start)
span_days <- round(log_span / ddays(1))

events |>
  count(day = wday(time, label = TRUE), hour = hour(time)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = day, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(
    title    = "When I Watch YouTube",
    subtitle = paste("From", format(log_start, "%b %d, %Y"),
                     "to",   format(log_end, "%b %d, %Y"),
                     "| span:", span_days, "days (~1.65 years)"),
    x = "Hour of day (Pacific time)",
    y = "",
    fill = "Videos"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## C. What Did You Do?

```{r}
#| label: p2-c
#| echo: false
events <- events |>
  filter(str_detect(title, "^Watched ")) |>
  mutate(
    song = str_replace(title, "^Watched ", ""),
    song = tolower(song),
    song = str_replace(song, " \\((official|lyric|audio|visualizer)[^)]*\\)", "")
  ) |>
  filter(!str_detect(song, "^https"))

top10 <- events |>
  count(song, sort = TRUE) |>
  head(10)

top10 |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = fct_reorder(song, n))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "My Most-Watched Videos",
    subtitle = "After removing \"Watched\", case differences, and official-video tags",
    x = "Times watched",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## D. Was I in Class?

```{r}
#| label: p2-d
#| echo: false
schedule <- tibble(
  day = c("Mon", "Wed", "Fri", "Mon", "Mon", "Wed", "Fri", "Tue", "Tue", "Thu", "Tue"),
  course = c("Stat 133", "Stat 133", "Stat 133", "Stat 133",
             "Stat 135", "Stat 135", "Stat 135", "Stat 135",
             "Stat 153", "Stat 153", "Stat 153"),
  start = c(8.5, 8.5, 8.5, 14, 11, 11, 11, 10, 18.5, 18.5, 14),
  end   = c(9.5, 9.5, 9.5, 16, 12, 12, 12, 12, 20, 20, 16)
)

events <- events |>
  mutate(
    day      = as.character(wday(time, label = TRUE)),
    clock    = hour(time) + minute(time) / 60,
    event_id = row_number()
  )

joined <- left_join(events, schedule, by = join_by(day),
                    relationship = "many-to-many")

in_class <- joined |>
  filter(
    clock >= start, clock <= end,
    time >= ymd_hms("2026-08-26 00:00:00", tz = "America/Los_Angeles"),
    time <= ymd_hms("2026-12-12 23:59:59", tz = "America/Los_Angeles")
  )

joined |>
  filter(!is.na(course)) |>
  group_by(course) |>
  summarize(videos_during_class = sum(
    clock >= start & clock <= end &
    time >= ymd_hms("2026-08-26 00:00:00", tz = "America/Los_Angeles") &
    time <= ymd_hms("2026-12-12 23:59:59", tz = "America/Los_Angeles")
  )) |>
  gt()
```

## E. Your Question
How has PinkPantheress's share of my YouTube watching changed over time?

```{r}
#| label: p2-e
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 4
pp_monthly <- events |>
  mutate(
    month = make_datetime(year = year(time), month = month(time), day = 1),
    is_pp = str_detect(song, "pinkpantheress")
  ) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(share = mean(is_pp))

pp_monthly |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = share)) +
  geom_line(color = "hotpink") +
  geom_point(color = "hotpink") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  labs(
    title = "How Much of My YouTube Is PinkPantheress?",
    subtitle = "Share of videos watched each month with PinkPantheress in the title",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Share of videos watched"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
``` 

::: {.notes}
**Answer:** She jumped from about 2% of my videos in early 2025 to a peak of
about 12% in June 2025, around when Fancy That came out, then settled to a
steady 3–6%, with smaller spikes in May and August 2026.

**Limitation:** this only counts titles that name her, so uploads like
"Tonight" with no artist are missed, and Feb 2025 and Oct 2026 are partial months.
:::

## F. What Do They Know?

**What YouTube could guess about me:**

- **When I sleep:** I almost never watch between 2 and 7 am
- **My routine:** busiest on weekend afternoons and weekday evenings
- **What I like:** PinkPantheress most of all, plus Slayyyter, Charli xcx, and EDEN
- **My habits:** I replay songs dozens of times and binge new albums

**Easiest guess to get wrong:** whether I'm paying attention. YouTube only knows
a video started. Most of mine are songs playing in the background, so
"57 videos during Stat 153" doesn't mean I was ignoring class.

**Would I ask them to delete anything?** Yes, my comments and live-chat messages.
I wrote those for one moment, not to be saved forever on my account.
